subject: HydraNet onboarding: invoice format, PO mapping, and payment terms
messages:
From: Sophie Garner <sophie.garner@hydranet.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jan 2028 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: HydraNet onboarding info + payment terms request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier — attaching our completed vendor onboarding form and bank remit CSV (two small files). A few quick items we need to align on before we can activate POs on our side: 

- Preferred billing cadence: HydraNet invoices monthly. We typically request Net 45 given our internal AR cycle. Would Redwood consider Net 45 for our initial 6-month onboarding period?
- Early-pay option: we can offer a 1.5% discount if paid within 10 days. Interested if that helps accelerate.
- Invoice format: we can send standard PDF invoices or EDI 810 if you can ingest.

Attachments: hydranet_onboarding_form.pdf, hydranet_bank_remit.csv

Let me know what fields you need for PO matching (PO number location, bill_to code, remit email). Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps.

Best,
Sophie Garner
Head of Finance Ops | HydraNet Systems
Sophie.Garner@hydranet.io

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Garner <sophie.garner@hydranet.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jan 2028 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HydraNet onboarding info + payment terms request

Hi Sophie — thanks for the form and remit file. A couple things from our side before we finalize: 

- PO matching: our AP system requires the PO number in the invoice header and either a bill_to_code (if the PO is routed to an internal cost center) or the ship_to address for non-stock invoices. Can you confirm which field HydraNet will populate?
- Invoice format: PDF invoices are fine for now; EDI would be great but not required for go-live.
- Terms: our default vendor terms are Net 30. We can escalate Net 45 for approved partners but need signoff from Finance for any early-pay discounts.

I'm looping Marissa from Finance to weigh in on the Net45 / early-pay request. If you can re-send the onboarding form with a scanned W-9 and proof of bank account in the same email thread, that will speed activation.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jan 2028 08:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: HydraNet onboarding info + payment terms request

On Fri, Jan 12, 2028 at 9:14 AM Sophie Garner <sophie.garner@hydranet.io> wrote:
> Hi Soojin,
> 
> Thanks for the quick intro earlier — attaching our completed vendor onboarding form and bank remit CSV...

Quick internal note — Finance here. A few suggestions: 

- Approve Net 45 for a 3–6 month trial to accommodate their billing cycle, but require a shorter payment window for an early-pay discount.
- Proposed commercial: Net 45 standard; 2% discount if invoice is paid within 10 days (we absorb some incremental ops cost but it's reasonable for strategic partners).
- PO mapping: require vendors include PO# and drop bill_to_code in the invoice header. We'll accept PDF invoices with the following remittance email: ap-invoices@redwood.com.

I'll attach our supplier onboarding checklist and mark items that need follow-up (W-9, bank verification). If accepted by Procurement, Finance will open a temporary Net45 term in AP and track performance.

Attachments: supplier_onboard_checklist.xlsx

- Marissa
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Sophie Garner <sophie.garner@hydranet.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jan 2028 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: HydraNet onboarding info + payment terms request

Thanks both — HydraNet accepts the proposed terms. Confirming the agreement we discussed: 

- Billing cadence: monthly invoices, Net 45 standard for the first 6 months.
- Early-pay: 2% discount if paid within 10 calendar days.
- Invoice requirements: PO# in the invoice header and bill_to_code when provided. PDF invoices to be sent to ap-invoices@redwood.com.

We will re-send the onboarding packet including a scanned W-9 and bank verification PDF later today. Once you confirm activation, we'll stage POs on our next monthly run.

Sophie Garner
Head of Finance Ops | HydraNet Systems
sophie.garner@hydranet.io
